subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 12, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - October 12, 2026**

**Headline:** AcreetionOS Shines as Easy-to-Use Alternative to Windows 10/11

In a recent article published on BetaNews, AcreetionOS has been hailed as the easy-to-use alternative to Windows 10/11. The article highlights AcreetionOS's user-friendly interface and seamless integration with the Cinnamon desktop, making it an attractive option for those looking to switch from Windows. This recognition is a testament to the hard work and dedication of the AcreetionOS community, and we're thrilled to see our project gaining recognition in the tech world.

**Community News**

* AcreetionOS has been featured in several recent articles, including a comparison of Arch Linux alternatives on NeoTeo and a report on the resignation of a prominent Arch Linux developer on Phoronix.
* LineageOS 24 has been released, and we're excited to see the continued growth and innovation in the Android ecosystem.
* Our community has been actively contributing to the project, with several commits and updates to the AcreetionOS-Xlibre repository.

**Practical Tip**

* Did you know that you can easily install AcreetionOS on a USB drive using our AcreetionMediaWriter tool? Simply download the tool from our website, follow the instructions, and you'll have AcreetionOS up and running on your USB drive in no time. This is a great way to try out AcreetionOS without affecting your existing system.
